# ARCH-6: Do not break what users already have

- Existing configurations, ground stations, log consumers and scripts keep working across an update. A change to user-visible behaviour, a default or a parameter's meaning is stated, migrated and released with notes, and old tools stay supported until they are deprecated. Changed log numbering broke QGC in [#14299](https://github.com/ArduPilot/ardupilot/pull/14299).

Confirmed 2026-10-14. Part of the root playbook, under [Architectural Principles](../claude/CLAUDE.md#architectural-principles). [All architectural rules](../README.md#architectural-rules)
